package.name: tank_patrol
package.description: Autonomous AI patrolling + AI-driven surveillance for The Tank Project. Provides: * Pure-Python patrol modes (waypoint + random walk) * ROS 2 patrol_node state machine with reactive /cmd_vel control * ROS 2 surveillance_node fusion of motion events + patrol phase * AlertJournal + CLI review tool Integrates with /security/events/motion (tank_security), /cmd_vel + /odom (tank_motion), /battery/state (tank_health), /estop (operator UI), /security/events/intruder (handoff back into tank_security for unified logging + MQTT).
